_comment: Chapter 2 has 11 cues of very mixed length. Cues 1–3 and 5–9 are short (2–8s); cue 4 is 14.5s, cue 7 is 13s, cue 10 is 35s. Match length to cue duration — Aria reads about 2.5 words per second.

cues.text: Electrical attributes: safety class, IP code, power factor.
Mechanical: housing dimensions, weight, IK rating. The fields populate as we click through, and the editor stamps each change into the live GLDF state in memory.
Applications — the closed XSD enum of intended use cases.
Approval marks — the certificates the luminaire ships with.
Hyperlinks for the manufacturer page and the product spec sheet. These show up on the overview and become clickable in downstream catalogs.
Emergency mode is tagged as Guide Light.

Marketing data. Housing color by RAL number, per variant — the RAL picker shows real sRGB swatches so the color choice is unambiguous. Two target markets, two approvals, and an industry award round out the marketing record. Notice how each setting on the variants page is scope-aware: editing on the variant tab overrides the product-level value, and you can see the inheritance indicator switch as you toggle between scopes.
Custom properties — vendor-specific extensions the XSD can't natively represent. None for this file.
